We seem to have got ourselves into another world,\ndamn...
What do you mean, damn!
What do you mean, damn!\nWhat the hell is going on?!
Well, it's all right.\nBeing reincarnated in another world has become\nquite a trend these days!
Do we have time to be talking about trends right\nnow?!
Oops, did I just make a mistake again?
Our...our secret base...\nYoshida!!\nI know you're careless, but this is just terrible!
Well, it doesn't look that much different from\nthat in the original world though. Plus, we don't\nneed to worry about paying rent here!
Oh! Y-you're right...!
Nice! I think the idea of conquering another world\nis fantastic!
Umm...They're talking about something like\nconquering the world. Isn't that dangerous?\nWhat do we do now?
Try talking to them.
Pretend not to hear anything.
Hey, interesting conversation over there, huh?
W-what are you guys?!\nYou look so three dimensional!!
1 head, 2 hands, and 2 legs...Hmm, you look like\nhumans, but I don't think you are...
Seriously?!\nThose guys are obviously shady, we can't just let\nthem roam free!!
Whoaaa?!
Wow, so three dimensional!!\nDo you live around here?\nI hope you're not weirdos.
You probably think that we're the weirdos here...\nHmm, you look like humans, but I don't think\nyou are...
H-hey, what are you doing?
Oh, my bad. Are you guys from here?
Sorry, I'm guessing that this place is...\nShimane, Japan?
Where is that?
Indeed!
Oh, thank god! Since you don't know, it's not\nShimane then.
Shimane is a nice place, but sometimes tough for\nthose who weren't born there...
It could be life-threatening...
Is it really that tough? Anyway, forget it!\nYou guys really need to calm down!
O-oh no, this is bad! Shimane is a wonderful\nplace, but some of the locals have adapted too\nwell to the natural environment and turned wild!
C-chancellor, hurry up and start a fire!!\nWild Shimane people are afraid of fire!!
There are no such people in Shimane!!
There are no such people in Shimane!!\nB-but, what you said might be true now!
Hey, aren't most living things afraid of fire in\ngeneral?! Let's all just calm down a little bit!
Sorry, I got confused for a moment...\nSo, you guys are the humans that live here, right?
What? Humans? You mean the Humes?\nIf that's what you mean, then no. I'm a Cule, so\nI guess that doesn't make me a human...
H-humes? Cule? What the hell are those???
Whooo, I like how those words sound!\nSuper-duper unfamiliar!!
Whooo, I like how those words sound!\nSuper-duper unfamiliar!!\nSo are there also creatures like Elves?
Uh, um, yeah...
Wow! So we're really in another world! I feel like\nliving in a fantasy world now!! With the\nplot armor, we'll be invincible from now on!
Lemme stop you right there! To us you guys are\nthe aliens here!! Why is your body so flimsy?\nWhich tribe do you actually belong to?
Not actually a tribe, but if we must say then...
We're E-A-G-L-E T-A-L-O-N
But we look dull because we're not 3D.
Hm?\nBut look, isn't your friend 3D though?
Whoaa?! I didn't notice it at all! What the hell?!
That's not fair! Why only you, doc?!
I bet their budget is not enough to turn all of\nus into 3D characters.
But I heard they'll make it 3D for the avatars!
You really sound like a character from an anime\ntoday, doc!
It hasn't been easy for many people these days.\nWell if that's the case, I guess it can't\nbe helped.
That's right! Besides, Dr. Leonardo is the\nevent boss, so of course his character will be 3D.
Yeah...hey, Yoshida! You're not supposed to reveal\nthat now, you know?!
Okay, whatever! Anyway, you can't pull out any\ntool from the backdrop here, can you? Isn't it\nimpossible to conquer this world without a tool?
T-that's true...
There doesn't seem to be any dollar stores here\neither to get materials for doc to invent\nsomething new.
Even for a doctor, it's gonna be difficult to\nmake a secret weapon out of nothing...
Oh, I knew you would say that, that's why I made\nit before we got transported here!
Look what's here!!
Isn't it Guignol?
My gosh, what the...you have something like this?!
Oooh!
Just what I expected from you doc, you're such a\ngenius!
Hey, wait a sec!\nHe just created such a terrible thing, you know?!\nHow could you just approve of it like that?!
Oh? I feel like I've seen it somewhere before...\nHow come you're using it?!
Well, that's because doc is a genius!
I second that!
Aight! We'll conquer this world in no time!\nC'mon, let's go!
I don't know who you are, but you've gotta be\nkidding me! You can't just come to someone else's\nworld and say you wanna conquer it!!
Hey, it's your time to shine!\nShow 'em what you got!
If you insist...
What? Why me?
I wonder how those two are related to each other.
Isn't it just a girl who is exploring this world\nwith her bodyguard?
Judging from the way the lil' girl acts and talks,\nshe seems to be the boss. The other one doesn't\neven talk at all...
Oh, so you can tell who the boss is?\nWell, what can I do? No matter how hard I try,\nI just can't hide it.
What the? Is the bodyguard not gonna fight?
Maybe the bodyguard is tired of being bossed\naround by the girl?
I'm sure that pose is the best thing the bodyguard\ncan do as a form of protest.
What are you doing?! Finish 'em immediately!!
Oh no, he got defeated...
Ugh...Just grin and bear it. He did put up a good\nfight against the residents of the world we've\nnever seen before...
What...? Bear...Did you say bear...?
I didn't expect you would fight so well against\nthe adventurer. For a bear, that's quite a feat!
Stop! Don't you dare call him a bear!!
C'mon, no matter how you look at him, he's a bear,\nisn't he?
He does look like a bear, but he's not!\nI repeat, he is not a bear, so never ever call him\na bear again!
I'm sick of hearing you keep saying the word\nbear...I'm NOT a bear!!
And things just turned ugly...
Episode 2 of the collab story will be added in\nthe next update! Look forward to it!
Hmm...So you don't know what happened and the next\nmoment you found yourself already here with your\nsecret base...Any idea how this happened, doc?
Had I known the cause, I'd have figured out a way\nto solve it. I'm like this because I don't know.
That’s not something to brag about, you know...
Oh...are we gonna be stuck in this world\nforever...?
N-no way!\nI have to work 3 part-time jobs tomorrow...
N-no way!\nI have to work 3 part-time jobs tomorrow...\nHow can I tell my manager if I'm stuck here!
Seriously?
Well, if we have to stay here for the time being,\nI guess we'll just have to proceed with the plan\nto conquer this world, right?
So...
Why don't you two join our organization,\nthe Eagle Talon? We can work together to conquer\nthis world!
I'll pass.
I'm kinda interested.
Hey, consider it again...\nYou should take up all sorts of challenges while\nyou're young, you know?
Now we're also holding a campaign to become a\nmonster! Don't you wanna try to look different\nfrom how you looked yesterday?
Imagine things like shooting laser beams from\nyour eyes, flying, or having 15 pairs of legs...
Hey, that way you'll just make them anxious!\nSay something nicer!
Um, well...we go on a trip with the members,\nbut only once every 4 years!
And we go on foot...All of the members also live\nand go to work together to raise funds for\nconquering the world...
It's a rewarding job and the atmosphere of the\nworkplace is very homely!
Okay enough!
Somehow you make us sound even more pathetic\neach time you open your mouth!!
Hey, you'd better not be!\nI don't think we'll get much in return!
Hey, don't say that!\nIf we can conquer the world, you can get whatever\nyou want!
Exactly! You can snack and sing as much as you\nwant, you know!!
S-shut up!! That sounds too good to be true!
For a moment you were contemplating my offer,\nweren't you?
You were thinking about the benefits you would\nget if you help us conquer the world, right?
W-what are you talking about! I was not...!
Bwahahaha! I'll never let that happen!!
T-this voice...
Whoa!
A friend maybe?
Perhaps a new enemy?!
W-who are you?! You know these 3 weirdos?
Yeah, I am...
This guy's name is Pedro Yama del Corazon,\naka Dumb Meathead in blue costume.
Who the hell is Pedro Yama del Corazon!!
DX Fighter...Why are you here too?
N-now what?! A-are you a bad guy?
I'm DX Fighter! A righteous hero that fights\nfor justice!
...What’s so righteous about you?
What do you mean...? I obviously look like someone\nwho would fight for the right thing!
Strongly disagree. You look like a pervert in\nblue costume.
T-t-that doesn't matter. What I wanna know more is\nwhy are you also here?
Wait, why is DX Fighter made into a 3D model\nbut not us? This is not fair and disrespectful!
Go get us our 3D models that are created as\navatars right now!
If you're that desperate, why don't you just go\nand open the avatar chest?
Orbs are required to open the chest and I don't\nhave any...
I see you're still so flimsy!\nServes you right! Yee-haw!
Should I just change my name to 3D DX Fighter\nstarting from today?\nBwahahaha!
Wait, so you were nearby when the doctor was\ngoing on a rampage with his crazy invention?
How could you just watch that happened and not\nstop him?
That's because...um...ah, right! I happened to see\na granny with an injured leg nearby, so treating\nher wound was my priority then...
You just made up a story there!
I know you just didn't wanna get in trouble and\nyou were actually on your phone right?!
Yeah, that must have been the case!
Shut up! Sounds like you've got a death wish!!
Delu...
Whoa!! H-hold on!\nSince we're all in another world, we shouldn't\nfight each other!
Exactly! If you spare us, we'll gift you with the\nplates that we don't want anymore!
I don't need those, idiot!!
Delu...
W-w-wait! You seem like a hero of justice, but\nunless they're bad guys, you can't just fire your\ndangerous special move at commoners of this world!
Come to think of it, you guys beat the destructive\nweapon that Leonardo created earlier. You guys are\ndangerous. I can't just leave you here.
Deluxe...
Oh my gosh! W-wa-waittt!\nWhy are we dangerous for beating the destructive\nweapon?!
That weapon was quite powerful.\nThe fact that you were able to beat it means\nyou're quite dangerous!
Deluxe...
I still don't get it!! How are we dangerous?!
If dangerous beings are not eliminated\nimmediately, there'll be hell to pay!
Deluxe Bo...
Oh, wait!! If you shoot that Bomber here, it will\nhit doc too!
Then we won't be able to go back to the original\nworld forever!\nAre you fine with that?!
What?!
Leonardo, you already know how to go back to\nthe original world?!
Nope!!
Deluxe Bomber!!
What?!
Bwahaha!
Bwahaha!\nDon't you underestimate this world,\nDX Fighter!
Hey, you're not the hero here!
W-what kind of world is this...I can't believe\nthere's someone more powerful than me...\nI don't wanna stay in this world any longer...
Oops, DX Fighter has been completely crushed...
Hmm, it's about time we returned to the original\nworld too...
Yeah...it's time to make dinner too...
But, you don't know how to get back to the\noriginal world...
Hey, how did you get here?
Well...as usual I stopped by the Eagle Talon's\nsecret base to charge my phone.
Because they're always plotting wicked schemes,
I released my Deluxe Bomber as usual...
Then I got surrounded by extremely bright white\nlight,
and the next thing I knew, I was here!!
Oh, right, now I remember!
I thought I was reincarnated in another world\nbecause my heart got run over by a truck while\ncrossing the street. False memory I guess.
What the hell, normally it should be your body,\nnot your heart!
Hmm. so that means...we're also here because of\nDeluxe Bomber, right?!
Well in that case, maybe you'll be able to go\nback to the original world if he releases that\nwhatever bomber one more time, right?
What?! Hell no!!
Hmm...I guess for the time being we can only stay\nhere and take over this world...
Don't worry, I found something that looks like a\nteleporter somewhere there a while ago and I've\nbrought it here!
Huh?!
Just what I expected from you doc!!
Hold on! When did you do that? And how?!\nWhat's more important is, you can't just take it\nwithout permission!!
Can we really go home, doc?
What? You don't trust me?!
No, no, that's not what I meant...\nBut what if we get transported to a weird place...
It would be nice if it were Shimane at least.\nI haven't been home in a while after all.
You gotta be kidding me! Who wants to go to\nShimane! What if we get attacked by the Shimane\npeople that have turned wild!
How many times do I have to tell you!!\nThere are no such people in Shimane!!
Ohhh, I wonder if they can really get home safely.
Alright, it's ready! I made some adjustments and\nit should be perfect now!
Well, since you're as powerful as me,\nI'll remember you.\nSo long!
C'mon, you got beaten to a pulp!
Thanks for everything!
I know it's not easy to deal with a weird\nsubordinate and doctor like them, but I wish you\ngood luck!
Oh, you're the only person that understands how I\nfeel... *sob*
This world is pretty interesting!
Also remember to mind your manners when taking\nrandom stuff from random places!
Okay!
Thanks for everything. It's a pity that we weren't\nable to conquer this world tho...
You've been saying that all the time!\nIf you really have the intention to conquer\nthis world, then come again sometime!
Okay! I'll definitely come back for a revenge to\ntake over this world!!
I did ask what was so righteous about you earlier,\nbut now I think you look like a hero. So just hold\nyour head high and go back to your world!
Y-you really think so?
Well, yeah, I'm a hero after all! Bwahahaha!
Alright, we're leaving then. Goodbye!
Okay, before we go, let's do it together...
E-A-G-L-E T-A-L-O-N
Phew~, what a bunch of dudes with excessive\nenergy. They somehow drained me of all my\nenergy...
Hey, I wonder if those weirdos from the\norganization called "Eagle Talon" have returned to\ntheir world safely...
I wonder where they got this from...
Do you know her?
Excuse me...\nHave you seen an unusual machine around here?
D-do you mean this thing?
Oh, yes! How did it get here...
Did you happen to see who moved it here?
Er...I'm not sure...it was already there when we\npassed by...haha, ahaha...
I see...
I'm sorry for the fuss...I'll get going then.
...Who is she...?
Oh? It's you guys...It's been a while!\nAnyway it's good to see you here.
Have you seen the teleporter that was in\nthe Dark Realm around here?
Oh! Why is it here...
Did you happen to see who moved it here?
Oh, some weirdos from another world br...
I see, so no one was here when you passed by...\nI wonder why they carried it out of the\nDark Realm...
I'm sorry for the fuss...I'll get going then.
Hey! Why did you do that to me?!
Oh my gosh, Goddess of Darkness! Ah-uh-oh!!
Oh? It's you guys...It's been a while!\nAnyway it's good to see you here.
Have you seen the teleporter that was in\nthe Dark Realm around here?
Oh! Why is it here...
Did you happen to see who moved it here?
I see, so no one was here when you passed by...\nI wonder why they carried it out of the Dark\nRealm...It's dangerous if not handled carefully...
Really?!
This world was created by the twelve gods a long\ntime ago. At the same time, teleporters were\ncreated by Almas, the chief god of this world.
This is one of the teleporters he created...\nNow it is mainly used to travel between the\nDark Realm and this world.
In some cases, it can also be used to travel to\nanother world...
It looks like they didn't use it the wrong way.
...However if not used right, the story goes that\nyou will be sent to a spooky maze.
What?!
The maze is overrun by monsters created by an\nunknown entity and no one knows where it ends...
No way, that's scary...I definitely don't wanna go\nto a place like that, even if someone asks me to.
Sorry for the fuss...I'll get going then.
Phew~...That was nerve-racking...What a crazy\nplace that doctor got that crazy stuff from!\nThank god we didn't get blamed for it...
Hey, I wonder what they're gonna do now.\nIt's gonna be troublesome if we let them stay\nlike this...Anyway, what do you need from me?
What are you waiting for!\nGo beat and finish that thing ASAP!\n...Huh, you need me? What is it about?
Hey, snap out of it!\nWe're done here, let's resume our journey!\nStill got stuff to do here? What is it? Tell me!
